owner_instruction: 分析负对照的收益来源和单年验证选模的稳定性，分析实验结果和模型原因，决定下一轮训练方案
research_reference: docs/etf-p3-research-plan-2026-10.md#21-负对照归因选模稳定性与下一轮训练方案2026-10-03

data.normalization: frozen M1 causal trailing z-score; no asset embeddings or new market encoder

target.label: u_i=e20_i-m_i-beta252_i*(e20_SPY-m_SPY); delta_i=u_i-kappa_i
target.beta252_i: causal trailing 252-session daily excess-return beta to SPY at decision close
target.kappa_i: per-asset training-only mean of u_i; ensures zero training mean for each learned residual target
target.SPY_residual: identically zero; excluded from residual IC/loss
target.cash_forecast: trailing BIL 20-session close return; realised future cash only in training labels

controls.shuffle_asset_columns: additional independently seeded within-block permutation of the eight residual asset columns; move masks jointly
controls.shuffle_source: training partition only; validation labels remain genuine and controls share checkpoint selection protocol
controls.primary_effect: paired improvement over zero-residual reconstruction and both capacity-matched shuffled MLP controls; control absolute profit is not alpha

training.loss: date-balanced Huber of training-standardized centered residual; no auxiliary rank objective in this pilot
training.checkpoint_criterion: same residual Huber loss on preceding checkpoint year
training.final_outer_epochs: per-seed median of best_epoch+1 from its three prior inner OOS fit receipts, bounded 1..80; no outer-year early stopping

walk_forward.outer_execution_rows: exact existing frozen test calendar; 2026 is partial to 2026-10-01
walk_forward.inner_eval_for_outer: for outer Y use only Y-3,Y-2,Y-1
walk_forward.inner_train: 2015 to inner_eval_year-2; purge labels against checkpoint start
walk_forward.inner_checkpoint: inner_eval_year-1; purge labels against inner_eval start
walk_forward.inner_evaluation: inner_eval_year; never used for checkpoint stopping of that fit
walk_forward.final_outer_train: 2015 through Y-1, labels realised before Y with purge and embargo; final epochs fixed by the three past inner fits
walk_forward.purge: actual 20-session label end strictly before next partition start minus five sessions
walk_forward.reuse_inner_fits: same input/target/architecture/seed/date contract cached once per unique inner eval year; no future inner receipt may affect an earlier outer fold

selection.baseline_fallback: zero_residual_reconstruction; momentum120 remains a fixed external comparator, not a annually switched fallback
selection.ledger_object: MLP: trade the arithmetic mean of five predictions before computing utility, identically in inner validation and outer test; deterministic Ridge: trade its single prediction once
selection.state: continuous shares, cash, drawdown and rolling turnover across the three inner evaluation years and across outer years; never reset annually
selection.prediction_gate: positive centered-residual RankIC in at least 2 of 3 prior inner years; MLP additionally requires at least 3/5 paired seeds; deterministic Ridge uses paired annual evidence without artificial seed votes; paired date-balanced rank increment >0.01 against both MLP null controls for MLP, and Ridge shuffle for Ridge
selection.signal_interval_gate: synchronous moving-date-block 95% paired residual RankIC-difference lower bounds >0 for 40/60/120 sessions, estimated only on three past inner years
selection.portfolio_increment: pooled three-year utility exceeds zero-residual reconstruction; leave-one-inner-year-out utility increment positive in at least 2/3 cases
selection.winner_stability: original winner retained >=0.70 for all 40/60/120-session synchronous block perturbations of the three-year validation ledger; observed hard constraints held fixed in this sensitivity diagnostic
selection.hard_constraints: no forced budget breach; cash >=0; voluntary rolling 252-session turnover <=4; existing exposure/cost/risk constants
selection.ties: simpler real candidate; failing either prediction or utility gate falls back to zero-residual reconstruction
selection.freeze: all seven selections, epochs and artifacts frozen before any new outer report is read
